attack: positive constant b on actual sends only, zero before onset
q_rule: after send: exact phase-averaged probability at D=-K*b_j; after silence: q=nu (no bet)
D0: fixed-horizon Azuma maximum test; horizon budget 2248, no onset reset
D1: fixed candidate b_j=0.10, LR starts at action 0
D2: strength mixture LR starts at action 0
D3: start-strength mixture with w_k=1/[k(k+1)], remaining tail 1/(n+1)
D4: finite-horizon union-calibrated Bernoulli CUSUM, sum_j pi_j max_k L_kj / H >= 1/alpha
offline_references: known-onset-and-strength matched event LR, using D reconstructed from true schedule and trusted bits
instantaneous onset alarm, zero post-onset pre-alarm loss, explicitly not deployable

primary_gate.interpretation: engineering targets chosen before new random samples; not a publication acceptance standard

confirmation_rule: all 24 settings receive an independent fixed 50000-episode final run; screen does not tune code, candidates, thresholds, or select settings
recovery: none; all detector outputs share the same unmodified monitor estimate
risk_metrics: actual pre-alarm summed MSE, both unconditional and conditional on no pre-onset alarm
full-window monitor MSE and paired excess vs healthy
restricted mean delay; never treat non-detections as missing
pre-onset alarms separate from post-onset detections
oracle event log-likelihood and conditional KL
numerics: translation-invariant error coordinates; no large absolute U1 states
not_claimed: uniform per-timestep positive bias or KL
MSE reduction without an implemented response
global innovation of mixture likelihood or CUSUM
all attacks impossible to detect from failure of these conservative candidates
